heroTitle: Turn your doomscrolling into a database.
heroSubtitle: The first "Read-it-Later" app built specifically for the chaos of short-form video.
bento1Sub: We extract the important stuff so you don't have to.
bento2Sub: One home for all your feeds.

oldDesc: Stop filling your camera roll with static images. Screenshots capture zero context, no audio, and no links. They are dead pixels.
newDesc: Transform your passive consumption into an active asset library. Organized, searchable, and always ready.
featLiveDesc: Links stay clickable. Jump back to the original context instantly.
featFreshDesc: Auto-updates if the creator edits the caption or metrics.
featInstantDesc: Search by color, object, transcript, or even visual mood.
role1Desc: Build competitor analysis boards and trend reports without clogging your personal feed.
role2Desc: Create dynamic moodboards that actually play video. Reference motion graphics instantly.
role3Desc: Save hook ideas, audio trends, and editing tricks. Add notes on how you'll remix them.
testimonial: "I used to have 5,000 screenshots in my 'Inspo' album. Recolekt actually lets me find the video I saved 6 months ago by searching for 'green dress'."
freeForever: Free forever for personal use. No credit card.
